name: 3m Bollinger 2.3x reversal (long)
_definition: Bar 1  PENETRATION : 3m close < lower BB(20, 2.3). Colour is recorded.
Bar 2  REVERSAL    : first candle of the OPPOSITE colour, within 3 bars.
Dojis (close == open) are neither colour and are skipped.
Bar 3  BUY TRIGGER : first bar closing ABOVE the reversal bar's CLOSE,
within 3 bars of the reversal bar.
FILL        : the OPEN of the bar after the trigger. Never the
trigger bar's own close — you don't know a close until
INVALIDATE  : any bar printing a low < reversal bar's low kills the
setup. Checked BEFORE the trigger on the same bar, so a
bar that runs the low and closes back up is a stop-run,
No cooldown needed here: the state machine can't re-arm mid-pattern and
advances past the trigger, so the duplicate-fire problem that killed
STOP is structural — the reversal bar's low — not a fitted percentile.
Mirror for shorts: band->upper, side->short, invalidate ref->reversal.high.
